title: Hi, I'm Marishka
paragraphs: I started The Girls Club because every girl deserves to feel glam, without spending hours in a salon chair or a fortune on lashes.
Our cluster lashes are made to be easy. Apply them yourself at home in minutes, or come see me and I'll do them for you. Either way, you leave feeling like the main character.
I'm a certified esthetician with a Bachelor's in Education, so whether I'm doing your lashes or teaching you in The Girls Club Academy, you're in trained hands.
This is just the beginning. More DIY beauty is on the way, made for Bajan girls who love a good glow up.
